Moon Hart (CV 28)

A luminous white hart with silver antlers and dark, thoughtful eyes. Its presence is associated with safe paths, lost travelers and the life energy spent to bring someone home.

Attributes: Brawn +1; Fortitude +2; Agility +2; Guile +1; Knowledge +1; Reason +2

HP: 26 · Speed: 9 · Size: 2 (2x2 squares) · Armor DR: 0

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: None · Stability: 1

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: None\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Moonlit antlers

The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: radiant.

Weak defense: Push 2. Standard defense: Push 1.

Battle Mending

One adjacent living ally; free hand (the hart’s antlers provide this). Pay 3 HP first, bypass resistance, and remain above 0. A player rolls this creature’s Reason: Weak heals 5, Standard 10, Strong 15 HP. Life resistance reduces healing, minimum 1. This spell provokes. Against a healing-harmed target instead, use Fortitude defense: Weak takes 15, Standard 10, Strong 5 Life damage. Same cost; no healing riders.

Sheltering Light

Light gathers over a companion like overlapping feathers, taking the harsh edge from the impact.

Before one visible willing ally within 3 squares takes damage from an attack, grant that ally Physical resistance 2 for that attack only. Use the highest matching resistance, not an added reduction; minimum damage rules remain. This does not heal, transfer damage or grant resistance to other types.

Warding Light

A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Silver hoof prints fade when the sun reaches them.

Purpose: Lead the lost out of places that mean to keep them.

Tactics and retreat: Heal a companion, then push pursuers aside; never stay to punish a defeated foe.

Counterplay and conversation: Show that someone needs rescue rather than trying to capture it.

Habitat: Moonlit forest · Communication: Understands Common and Fey; communicates through simple images

Loot: A safe route or a returned lost possession.

Summoning: Fey 7 — @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.24b9beaa44571e2f.JournalEntryPage.ec1f663495e4d995]{player reference}.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-moon-hart

Category: Fey · Role: Rescuer · CV: 28

Difficulty rationale: An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

Reference damage: 4/5/7

Reference type: radiant

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.65

Action review (#1279): U 1.5 → 1.65: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=4.404, O=5.162. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
